title: View menu: snap/grid toggles and Edit Grid dialog
description:
## Problem

The View menu only contains a single item (Rulers). Flash 8's View menu includes five snap/grid controls that are all missing from the MenuBar:

- View > Snapping > Snap to Grid  (Ctrl+Shift+;)
- View > Snapping > Snap to Guides (Ctrl+Shift+\)
- View > Snapping > Snap to Objects (Ctrl+Shift+/)
- View > Grid > Show Grid  (Ctrl+')
- View > Grid > Edit Grid...  (Ctrl+Alt+G) — opens a dialog to set grid color, width, height

The underlying model (docProperties.grid.snapToGrid, docProperties.snapToObjects, docProperties.snapToGuides, docProperties.grid.showGrid/gridWidth/gridHeight/gridColor) is fully implemented and StageArea already consumes all of these props. Only the menu surface and an Edit Grid dialog are missing.

## Work required

1. **MenuBar.tsx** – Add a 'Snapping' sub-group and a 'Grid' sub-group inside the View menu. Each snap item should show a checkmark prefix when active (matching the Rulers pattern). Wire callbacks: onSnapToGrid, onSnapToObjects, onSnapToGuides, onToggleGrid, onEditGrid.

2. **Shell.tsx** – Wire the new MenuBar callbacks to pushDoc mutations that toggle docProperties.grid.snapToGrid, docProperties.snapToObjects, docProperties.snapToGuides, docProperties.grid.showGrid. Add an onEditGrid handler that opens an Edit Grid dialog.

3. **EditGridDialog.tsx** – New dialog (similar to DocumentPropertiesDialog) with fields for: grid width (px), grid height (px), grid color (hex swatch), snap to grid (checkbox), show grid (checkbox). On confirm, pushDoc with updated docProperties.grid.

## Acceptance

- Clicking View > Grid > Show Grid toggles the grid overlay on/off (same as Ctrl+' already does).
- Clicking View > Grid > Edit Grid... opens the dialog; setting width=20, height=20 and confirming changes the displayed grid spacing.
- Snap to Grid / Snap to Objects / Snap to Guides checkmarks in the View menu track the doc-model state; clicking toggles them.
- No TypeScript errors (pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui tsc --noEmit clean).
